validationIssues.EMPTY_COLUMN_NAME: Column "{{columnOriginal}}" in table "{{tableName}}" has an empty SQL name.
validationIssues.AUTO_INCREMENT_ID_COLUMN_REQUIRED: Auto-increment is enabled for table "{{tableName}}", but the ID column name is empty.
validationIssues.AUTO_INCREMENT_ID_START_AT_INVALID: The auto-increment start value for table "{{tableName}}" must be an integer.
validationIssues.INSERT_NO_COLUMNS_SELECTED: Table "{{tableName}}" has no selected columns to generate INSERT statements.
validationIssues.UPDATE_PRIMARY_KEY_REQUIRED: Table "{{tableName}}" requires a valid primary key to generate UPDATE statements.
validationIssues.DELETE_PRIMARY_KEY_REQUIRED: Table "{{tableName}}" requires a valid primary key to generate DELETE statements.
validationIssues.UPDATE_NO_COLUMNS_TO_UPDATE: Table "{{tableName}}" has no remaining columns to UPDATE after removing the primary key.
validationIssues.RELATIONSHIP_PARENT_PK_REQUIRED: Table "{{childTable}}" depends on the parent key from "{{parentTable}}", but that key is not configured correctly.
validationIssues.RELATIONSHIP_AUTO_INCREMENT_REQUIRED: Parent table "{{parentTable}}" must enable auto-increment for the configured foreign key.
validationIssues.RELATIONSHIP_MAPPING_INCOMPLETE: The relationship between "{{childTable}}" and "{{parentTable}}" does not cover all required parent key columns.
validationIssues.RELATIONSHIP_FK_IDENTIFIER_CONFLICT: Foreign key column "{{fkColumn}}" conflicts with another SQL column already included in "{{childTable}}".
validationIssues.RELATIONSHIP_FK_COLUMN_REQUIRED: Table "{{childTable}}" has a configured foreign key, but no foreign key column was defined.
validationIssues.RELATIONSHIP_EXTERNAL_PARENT_NOT_FOUND: The configured parent table for "{{childTable}}" was not found or is not selected for generation.
validationIssues.RELATIONSHIP_SOURCE_COLUMN_REQUIRED: Table "{{childTable}}" does not have the source column required to map parent key "{{columnOriginal}}".
validationIssues.RELATIONSHIP_SOURCE_COLUMN_TYPE_MISMATCH: Invalid relationship between "{{childTable}}" and "{{parentTable}}": child column "{{childColumn}}" is {{childType}}, but parent key "{{parentColumn}}" is {{parentType}}.
validationIssues.RELATIONSHIP_COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH: Invalid relationship: the number of parent key columns differs from the number of child reference columns.
validationIssues.RELATIONSHIP_ROW_KEY_INCOMPLETE: Row {{csvLineNumber}}: table "{{childTable}}" does not contain all values required to resolve the key in "{{parentTable}}".
validationIssues.RELATIONSHIP_PARENT_ROW_NOT_FOUND: Row {{csvLineNumber}}: no parent record could be found for key {{logicalKey}} in "{{parentTable}}".
validationIssues.INVALID_TYPED_VALUE: Row {{csvLineNumber}}: column "{{columnOriginal}}" in table "{{tableName}}" is configured as {{expectedType}}, but value "{{rawValue}}" is invalid.
validationIssues.VALUE_LOSES_LEADING_ZERO: Column "{{columnOriginal}}" in table "{{tableName}}" starts with zero in value "{{rawValue}}". Configure it as string to preserve the original value.
validationIssues.VALIDATION_ISSUE_LIMIT_REACHED: Too many row-level issues were found. Only the first {{maxIssues}} were listed.

fileRead.FILE_DECODING_ERROR: Failed to read or decode CSV file {{fileName}}.

sqlGeneration.WORKER_RUNTIME_ERROR: SQL generation failed while running in the background.
sqlGeneration.WORKER_INVALID_RESPONSE: SQL generation returned an invalid response.

sql.noColumnsToUpdate: Error: no columns left to UPDATE in {{tableName}} after removing the selected PKs
